snippet.title: Is 30LPA Enough to Live in Banglore?
snippet.description:
What does it really cost to live in Bangalore in 2026?

If you’ve ever wondered:
- Is Bangalore actually expensive?
- How much rent do you pay near tech hubs?
- Can you save money on a ₹2 lakh/month salary?
- What’s a realistic monthly expense in Bangalore?
- This is the most honest breakdown you’ll see.

In this video, we break down the complete monthly budget of a Google software engineer earning ₹30 LPA — from rent and food to travel, lifestyle, and investments.

Key Takeaway:
You don’t need a ₹30 LPA salary to survive in Bangalore.
You can live comfortably even at ₹40–50K/month — if you plan it right.

Who Should Watch This:
Students planning to move to Bangalore
Software engineers & IT professionals
Anyone curious about salary vs lifestyle in India
People comparing cities like Delhi, Mumbai & Bangalore

Why This Video is Different
Most people guess expenses.
We show you real numbers, real lifestyle, and real trade-offs.
